
'''Modding''' refers to modifying Dwarf Fortress's files (or, indeed, the files of any other game) to change some element of gameplay, usually by a third-party developer or the end user.  In ''Dwarf Fortress'', this usually refers to changes to the so-called ''raws'', the game files that describe a wide range of elements, ranging from what [[plant]]s can be milled, to what kinds of [[rock]] exist, to how empires are formed.

Most editing involves adding or removing "tokens" from the raw files.  The [[token]]s are the actual parameters for each item, and that article is a good place to start.
